title: The Team That Had to Defend Both Goals
titleSupport: Only if the live Reel composer exposes a separate title field; otherwise use the post caption without inserting an extra title.
description:
A football team deliberately scored an own goal. Then they had to defend both goals.

Barbados needed a two-goal win against Grenada to qualify in 1994. A one-goal victory would still eliminate them. An unusual extra-time rule made an equalizer useful—until Grenada saw a way to qualify by scoring at either end.

Original illustrated reconstruction, not match footage. AI-generated narration.

#FootballHistory #CaribbeanCup
firstComment: The objective was qualification, not just winning this match. The rule changed what each team needed from the same scoreline.
